metrics.workdir_dsl:
workspace "Claims Center" "The insurance company's claims platform" {
    model {
        policyholder = person "Policyholder" "Reports claims and tracks their progress"

        claimsCenter = softwareSystem "Claims Center" "The insurance company's claims platform" {
            webPortal = container "Web Portal" "Where policyholders report claims and track their progress"
            mobileAppBackend = container "Mobile App Backend" "Serves the insurer's mobile app"
            intakeService = container "Claims Intake Service" "Registers new claims"
            triageService = container "Triage Service" "Classifies and prioritizes claims"
            assessmentService = container "Assessment Service" "Calculates settlement amounts"
            payoutService = container "Payout Service" "Executes claim settlements"
            fraudScreeningService = container "Fraud Screening Service" "Flags suspicious claims"
            documentService = container "Document Service" "Accepts claim photos and reports"
            notificationService = container "Notification Service" "Emails and messages policyholders"
            assignmentService = container "Assignment Service" "Routes claims to adjusters"
            adjusterWorkbench = container "Adjuster Workbench" "Where staff process their assigned claims"
            policyVerificationService = container "Policy Verification Service" "Checks that a claim is covered by the policy"
            reinsuranceAllocationService = container "Reinsurance Allocation Service" "Apportions large losses across reinsurance partners"
            batchScheduler = container "Batch Scheduler" "Runs the nightly reserves calculation"
            eventQueue = container "Event Queue" "Carries claim events between the application parts"
            claimsDatabase = container "Claims Database" "Stores claim records"
            policyDatabase = container "Policy Database" "Stores policy and cover records"
            auditDatabase = container "Audit Database" "Stores the compliance audit trail"
            documentStore = container "Document Store" "Holds claim photos, reports, and correspondence"

            webPortal -> intakeService "reaches"
            webPortal -> assessmentService "reaches"
            webPortal -> payoutService "reaches"
            webPortal -> documentService "reaches"
            webPortal -> notificationService "reaches"

            mobileAppBackend -> intakeService "reaches"
            mobileAppBackend -> assessmentService "reaches"
            mobileAppBackend -> payoutService "reaches"
            mobileAppBackend -> documentService "reaches"
            mobileAppBackend -> notificationService "reaches"

            intakeService -> triageService "hands accepted claims"
            triageService -> assessmentService "routes claims"
            assessmentService -> payoutService "requests settlements"

            assignmentService -> adjusterWorkbench "routes claims"

            documentService -> documentStore "reads"
            batchScheduler -> claimsDatabase "reads and writes"
            batchScheduler -> policyDatabase "reads and writes"
        }

        claimsDataBureau = softwareSystem "National Claims Data Bureau" "A national claims data bureau operated by a different organization"
        clearingHouse = softwareSystem "Clearing House" "A clearing house operated by a different organization"

        policyholder -> webPortal "reports claims and tracks progress"
        policyholder -> mobileAppBackend "reports claims and tracks progress"

        fraudScreeningService -> claimsDataBureau "consults"
        payoutService -> clearingHouse "executes settlements through"
        notificationService -> policyholder "reports claim status changes"
    }
}
